notes.title: Tokyo Game Show and More!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/e52f91a7ec89124d7e8b3a8b9ab40ef8e02a6dde.png"][/img][/p][p]Attention Adventures[/p][p][/p][p]We are embarking on a new journey. Since our previous story at Gamescom Germany has come to an end, we are excited to announce that we will be attending [b]Tokyo Game Show[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Get ready for an adventure full of excitement in this next devlog.[/p][h2]
[b]What will we cover?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]In this devlog, we will be covering:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Our participation at the Tokyo Game Show (TGS)[/p][/*][*][p]More exciting updates to the Demo[/p][/*][*][p]What's coming next![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Tokyo Game Show and Our Participation[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]What are we doing at TGS?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]LightsUp![/b] will be showcased for the very first time at [b]Tokyo Game Show[/b], under our awesome partner [b]Red Dunes Games[/b]! 🎉
[/p][p]We’ve prepared a brand-new build of the game exclusively for TGS. Players visiting our booth will be the first in the world to try out this upgraded version of LightsUp! We can’t wait to see the chaos, laughter, and fun unfold.[/p][p]
Red Dunes Games has also prepared many special activities where you can win unique goodies from our game. Curious what they are? You’ll have to drop by the [b]Red Dunes Games booth[/b] to find out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/34cca78495cd4eac530e9890ff3b91499ad86d2d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Our approach to TGS![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This build has upgrades, new mechanics, and plenty of party-fueled chaos. Our goal at TGS is to see players dive into the game, share in the fun, and help us gather valuable feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]With the help of Red Dunes Games, we’ll collect your thoughts and impressions to polish LightsUp! Even further. We’ve been working hard to ensure every player at TGS has an unforgettable experience, and we hope you’ll feel the energy when you play.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Early Booth Design![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]With Red Dunes Games and Bugblio Studio, we’ve been designing a booth that truly captures the spirit of LightsUp!. We’ve shared lore, art, and ideas to ensure the space feels alive and full of character.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/51030f654e7c8d8901535f0662d2300ff4954f63.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Exciting Updates to the Demo[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]What has changed?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This new build is our most significant leap forward yet. We’ve significantly improved combat, storytelling, and overall quality of life.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Thanks to an improved tutorial, new players will find the game easier to pick up.[/p][/*][*][p]Returning players will notice smoother combat, better pacing, and fresh surprises.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Exploration, battles, and progression all feel more exciting than ever before.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/34df9f6f4037d9c7c9b905aae58d3d9a3301c057.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]What to look out for![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Of course, we don't want bugs or crashes during TGS. That’s why our team has already spent over 50 hours testing this build to make it as stable and polished as possible.
[/p][p]For those who can’t make it to TGS, we plan to release this new demo for everyone in October. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Extra tips for players:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Here’s a pro tip: communication is everything. Talk, strategize, shout, or even scream with your teammates! It’ll make a huge difference in taking down our powerful new boss.
[/p][p]Mix and match your favorite characters and weapons, experiment with builds, and most importantly: have fun playing your way.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/a3efeeaf57dc3d471205de119fc8a482def04111.gif"][/img][/p][h3]
[b]What's new in this Build:[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]New level design[/p][/*][*][p]New enemies[/p][/*][*][p]A POWERFUL new boss[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh game mechanics[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/5ff6ae1bbe48d889fc151658f3f0de78cb6a071a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]What's Coming Next![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Next month's plans![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’ll head to Gamescom Asia 2025 x Thailand Game Show in October! We’re incredibly honored to have been nominated as part of the Thai Game Studio showcase, and your votes mean the world to us. 💙
[/p][p]👉 Vote for us here: Facebook voting link[/p][p][/p][p]If you’re attending, come by our booth for fun activities and special gifts prepared together with Red Dunes Games and Bugblio Studio. Thai and international players alike, we’d love to see you, so don’t be shy and say hi! 🙂[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/64ca0bc61f975139d23e18185bc500b639d43f96.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]A small teaser...[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We can’t share everything yet, but keep your eyes on our upcoming trailer - it’ll reveal some exciting new features we’ve been working on. 👀[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266750/LightSup/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: LightSup! At Gamescom
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Lightbearers![/p][p]
We’ve made it back from Germany, with lots to talk about… Now that we’ve had a moment to catch our breath. [/p][p][/p][p]This was not our first time being at Gamescom. Our team was in Cologne back in 2023, showcasing LightSup!. However, this year was the first time we had our very own booth for LightSup! As part of the Thailand Game Pavilion.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/59da4b7143e7c093a61667c17e053c6b6b563716.jpg"][/img][/h2][h2][b]So, How was Gamescom?[/b][/h2][p][i]"We saw strangers turn into teammates within minutes. That’s exactly what we dreamed this game could be."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]"Great" feels like an understatement. “Surreal” might be more accurate; the entire event was overwhelming in the best way possible. Honestly, we were a bit nervous at first. Would they get the culture and humor? 

Seeing players and developers from so many countries walk up and instantly get into the chaos…[/p][p][/p][p]Until the laughter, the shouting, the dancing at the altar... it all clicked. We saw strangers turn into teammates within minutes. That’s exactly what we dreamed this game could be.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]A Learning Experience [/b][/h2][p][i]"Players are amazing at breaking your game in ways you never expected."[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/daeffd9dc3a8073898f4b3490941d46c115408fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While watching people play, we realized quickly there were things we didn't even think about while making and testing LightSup! The tutorials were one such moment where we realised: Players are blowing right past the tutorials. We've got to find a way to get them to pay attention so they'll actually learn what's going on and understand the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Players are amazing at breaking your game in ways you never expected. We also noticed some players tried to solo the rituals while others completely ignored the light system, which told us that we need better onboarding or feedback. [/p][p]
We also saw some beautiful moments, like a parent and child playing together and figuring out how to “pray” to the altar in sync. It reminded us that [i]LightSup![/i] has that magical ability to connect people, regardless of age or skill level.

Watching these moments, you get a true sense of how important this feedback is. This is not just gathered through surveys but also by observing how players interact in person. Without it, developing a game based on a singular, internal perspective can often lead to cognitive bias and a narrow focus on specific design vectors.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/a312665be7dd81efc2e682d42b5e12891f0fa5c3.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p]It’s everything. You spend months and years crafting systems, but until real players touch them, you’re still in the dark. Diversified feedback offers a multi-faceted analysis, allowing us to identify and integrate previously unconsidered elements. [/p][p][/p][p]The most valuable part is the emotional response. That’s what we have done so far. If people are smiling, laughing, yelling “Nooo!” together—that’s the best design signal we could ask for.[/p][h2][/h2][h2][b]Will you be back?[/b][/h2][p][i]"If Gamescom has us, we’ll be back. Hopefully, with even crazier future new games."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The short answer is: Yes, we will!

Cologne is such a special place for us. It’s where we first showcased [i]LightSup![/i] At Devcom back in 2023, it felt like coming full circle this year. I love the energy here. If Gamescom has us, we’ll be back. Hopefully, with even crazier future new games. (LightSup! 2 maybe!?)[/p][p][/p][p]Gamescom hardly marks the end of our events this year. Before 2025 is up, we’re continuing to take LightSup! Across the world.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/cb50f06cb66d7141debf37ddb2e3650a5b3e3e3f.png"][/img]
[b]The Future is full of Light.[/b][/h2][p][i]"Our PC release is planned for late 2025, and the console launch follows in 2026."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Next up, we’re taking LightSup! to the [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b] this September for our biggest event and booth yet, all with our awesome partners at Red Dunes Games! We've got a special gift ready for everyone who drops by our booth at TGS.

Followed shortly by the [b]October Steam Next Fest[/b] and then headed home, right where we created the game for [b]Gamescom Asia x Thailand Game Show 2025,[/b] with a huge surprise planned in October as well. [/p][p]
Needless to say, our team will be very busy!

[b]Our PC release is planned for late 2025, and the console launch follows in 2026.[/b] We also hope to do local showcases back home in Thailand, especially to inspire students and young developers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/727a2d51b3d5f7ed60dd563008dab9f29d94e61b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With all that said, our team has one final thought about Gamescom 2025: It was an awesome opportunity to bring a small indie game from Thailand and let players worldwide enjoy it.[/p][p]
We’d like to give a big heartfelt THANK YOU. 

To the organizers, everyone who dropped by, and fellow indie teams who cheered us on, being an indie from Thailand, showing your game on a world stage can feel intimidating. But the kindness and support we received reminded us that games really do transcend boundaries. 


See you again at the future Gamescom. Thanks for everything.[/p][p align="center"]-Bugbilo Studio 💛[/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/a08e79c3f957eace8170f2c25e187b9c7981f543.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Join the Community on [url="https://discord.gg/8DxjtzFcVE" style="button"]Discord![/url]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266750/LightSup/"][/dynamiclink][/h3]

notes.title: A New World and Mini Boss Preview
notes.content:
[p]Hello Adventurers! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has checked out LightSup! and played the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266750/LightSup/"]demo[/url] during the Southeast Asian Games Showcase! We are so proud of the progress being made in LightSup! with your support and feedback.[/p][p]
Our demo is a slice of what you can expect in the lands of Lumineia, so we wanted to take a moment to share some of our most recent development.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/426e43fb4b6b391422b5e4c2c635dfeaa1e63562.png"][/img]Welcome to the Living Forest[/h2][h2]‎ [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/bd853a9ab2a99e5700eaf72e1a86946a48c93ed9.png"][/img][/h2][p]The Living Forest is the second land you’ll travel to in hopes of bringing back the light. It’s a strange land full of stranger creatures and hidden secrets. We wanted to create a surreal area using blues, purples and greens with shadowed lighting to build a surreal area to explore.[/p][p][/p][p]But the aesthetic is not the only thing that makes this forest the strangest…[/p][p]‎ [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/f7ad98f134f28e123a8de778b4fad358fa30daa2.gif"][/img]‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎[/p][h3]‎[b]The Lore[/b] [/h3][p]Long ago, this land housed a magical research facility that discovered rifts to other dimensions. A disastrous experiment tore reality apart, collapsing the facility and trapping the land in a warped space—those who enter may reappear elsewhere or vanish entirely.[/p][p][/p][p]Over time, nature consumed the ruins, and the forest earned a cursed reputation among locals. Now known as the Devouring Forest, it’s a place of mystery and danger—where few return, and even fewer understand what lies within. [/p][p][/p][p]Spooky huh? We cannot wait for you all to get a chance to explore (and hopefully) return from the Living Forest… but it won't be easy.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]‎New Mini Boss & Enemies[/b][/h3][p]In addition to the winding paths leading Bearers of Light astray, we’ve also created brand new enemies specific to the Living Forest. Strange and (sometimes) cute, you’ll have to face off against several new enemy types. ‎[/p][h2] ‎ ‎  ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/bf21630f6e731a0056f4bc1e5eb274776380fc35.png"][/img]‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/ad07ef28ce99a41f1b491e08e7e660fdf6c06034.png"][/img] ‎[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/e91f624c5c45da411b97efc1fdac7ea632daf204.png"][/img]  ‎ ‎[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/c5d48d0e2c7f61f7be258e4d6fbc5fac3bfa3b1c.png"][/img][/h2][h2] ‎[/h2][h3]‎[b]Meet Golem, The Protector, a new Mini Boss[/b][/h3][h3]  ‎ ‎[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/207e58f6bf88bbbfee19be9ed078d4ffb113cdb3.gif"][/img] ‎[/h3][p]Golem, The Protector is a brand new boss you will encounter in the Living Forest. Built from ancient stone and magic, it guards key areas with powerful melee strikes and elemental defenses, adding challenge and lore to the dungeon.  [/p][p]Pray as fast as you can to create light while dodging powerful attacks. Be patient for the opportunity to attack and you’ll be able to fell the mighty Golem. But beware… he is not the only big baddie in the Living Forest… larger monsters lurk in the dark.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/0f6e340fce2fb5ac666a0ddbad3c82a700dceb0f.png"][/img][/h3][p]Those are just a few new pieces of content to look forward to in LightSup!’s second world, The Living Forest, releasing later this year. Stay vigilant against the dark and for more news on the ongoing development of LightSup! There is so much more behind the curtain!   If you have any feedback or bug reports for us regarding the demo or just want to join our growing community of Light Bearers, join us on [url="https://discord.gg/8DxjtzFcVE" style="button" buttoncolor="#fea120"]Discord.[/url]  

Thanks for reading, we cannot wait to share more!
                                                                     - BugBlio Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: LightSup! Endless Replayability Updated Demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44311942/ee451bf3488637377e78412667571cb00a9a7f41.jpg[/img]

Greetings everyone

We're really excited to announce a brand-new update for LightSup! The demo is now available and packed with exciting new features, improvements, balancing, and bug fixes. Whether you're a seasoned explorer or new to Eclipseia, this latest version offers something for everyone to enjoy.

[h2][b]New Features:🌟[/b][/h2]
Dive deeper into the adventure with expanded gameplay mechanics. And discover a variety to progress the game.

[b]Party Upgrade Progression:[/b]
Party upgrades are a great way to boost your team's capability in the game. These upgrades affect the entire game, including all unlocked characters.
[list]
[*] [b]Altar Blessing:[/b] Unlock Party Perk rewards.
[*] [b]Camping:[/b] Recover characters’ HP once the players complete the quest.
[*] [b]Consciousness:[/b] Reduce fear damage while staying in the darkness.
[*] [b]Stargazing:[/b] Increase Nightmare Time to occur.
[*] [b]Bright Light:[/b] Increase every Altar of Light radius.
[*] [b]Strong Mind:[/b] Recover Sanity faster.
[*] [b]Protection of the Light:[/b] Reduced Damage while staying Light.
[*] [b]Believer:[/b] Start with extra faith.
[*] [b]Warehouse:[/b] Increase Shop Slot Display.
[*] [b]New Arrivals:[/b] Increase Refresh times during encounters at Dungeon Shop.
[/list] [b]Dungeon Crossroad:[/b] Players can choose a rewarding path when exploring deep down through the dungeon.

[b]Dungeon Weapon Upgrade:[/b] This occurs when a player interacts with weapons lying on the ground or sold in a shop. Players can pick up the same weapon to upgrade to a higher rarity.

[b]Quick Communication:[/b] Communication Wheel that pops out at the character when the player presses and holds a key command. (Up - Hey / Down - Help! / Left - Follow Me~ / Response: OK!)

[b]Status Booster:[/b] a special attribute booster item discovered during a game session by completing a quest or encountering special events. Encourage players to build each character differently every time they jump into the dungeon.

[b]Localization System:[/b] Localization is implemented to be ready for localization.

[h2][b]Content Addition:✨[/b][/h2]
[b]New Weapons:[/b]
[b]New Party Perks:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Crescent Moon:[/b] When the player uses the skill 3 times, it automatically shoots a Crescent Moon projectile in the same direction the Player faces.

[*] [b]Skill Mania:[/b] Double mana gain, 30% faster skills, BUT take 20% more damage.

[*] [b]Lightning Strike:[/b] Critical hits summon lightning strikes on the enemy!

[*] [b]III-Wisher:[/b] Have a 30% increased chance of applying status effects.

[*] [b]Sonic Boom:[/b] Dashing creates a sonic boom and inflicts "Break Status" to nearby enemies.

[*] [b]Ready in Action:[/b] Starting each room will grant a protection shield.

[*] [b]Armor Bursts:[/b] After losing 30, “Vilcor Armor” will be explosive and deal damage in a small circle.

[*] [b]Run’ Lala Run:[/b] Keep Walking for 3 seconds to gain 5 mana!

[*] [b]Emergency Medicine:[/b] When in a critical situation(Red blinking screen), the HP potion Healing skill increases its effect by 40%.

[*] [b]Elixir:[/b] When picking up any potion, receive invincible for 3 seconds.

[*] [b]Panacea:[/b] The potion will be dropped as a “Panacea,” Recovering both HP and MP.

[*] [b]Lucky Dodge Time:[/b] Lucky Dodge has a chance to dodge by 15%.

[*] [b]Fortified Strike:[/b] When landing a Critical Damage, Generate 5 points of Vilcor Armor.

[*] [b]Bulwark:[/b] Use the skill 3 times to generate Vilcor armor for 15 points.

[*] [b]Last Man Stand:[/b] Random auto-revives 1 player when all players are down.

[*] [b]Life Force:[/b] While losing HP 150 points, generate Vilcor armor for 30 points.

[*] [b]Sweeping Kick:[/b] When doing a normal attack with a total of 2,000 Damage, Create a sweeping kick surround 1 time. The effect will be an individual character.

[/list] [b]New monsters:[/b] Slime / Golden Suicider / Golden Goblin

[h2][b]Improvements:✨[/b][/h2]
Enhanced visuals and animations for a more immersive experience. Streamlined UI for smoother navigation and interaction. Optimized performance for smoother gameplay on a variety of devices.
[h3][b]Performance:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the Pooling System to reduce performance spikes further.
[*] Optimized numerous Visual Effects and Combat Effects.
[*] Improved GPU visibility occlusion culling and general handling of off-screen content.
[*] Removed unnecessary cameras and adjusted some camera coding.
[/list] [h3][b]Quality of Life:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Revised Input Interaction Button to use only one button.
[*] Added Red-dot Notification for new content received or feature unlocked.
[*] Added UI Navigation Indicator in Dungeon
[*] Added Floating Text when receiving combat effect (buff/debuff)
[*] Players can now enter the next dungeon room simply by standing before the gate without pressing any button.
[*] Added VFX standing area close to the next dungeon gate.
[/list] [h3][b]Game Characters:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Polished character animations when using skills on new weapons.
[*] Updated Quill and Timid Tim traits to support solo players.
[*] Updated Fyvana's traits to knock out enemies while praying.
[/list] [h3][b]Dungeon:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved collision, faders, and texture in Ruined Castle.
[/list] [h3][b]Setting:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Custom Key Rebinding Options for the keyboard and controllers
[*] Forced remove user when controller disconnected on the lobby.
[*] Friendly Fire is now set to be off as default.
[/list] [h3][b]Visual:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved splash screen flow
[*] Update Aura Blade particle
[*] Improved animation motion when picking up materials
[*] Reworked VFX skills on Warbow and Lunarian Bow.
[*] Reworked VFX skill and Icon of Fireball to Firepit
[*] Reworked VFX skill and Icon of Iceball to Icespike
[*] Reworked Heal skill Icon
[*] Polished Black Knight animations.
[*] Polished Ember Knight animations.
[*] Revised Skeleton Slasher visual.
[*] Increased the asset size of Monster Leader.
[/list] [h3][b]Audio:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated ambiance sound of Ruined Castle and Tutorial.
[*] Improved audio for the game lobby.
[*] Added SFX when choosing perks.
[*] Changed SFX when players hit Monster Portal
[*] Adjust Goblin dead pitch value
[*] Added SFX to Father Q when interacting with Dungeon Shop.
[/list] [h2][b]Balancing:⚖️[/b][/h2]
Fine-tuned difficulty levels for a challenging yet rewarding gameplay experience. Adjusted progression to ensure a balanced and enjoyable journey through Eclipseia.
[list]
[*] Added Inflict Status Effect to normal attacks of some weapons based on their weapon characteristics. (Burn, Stun, Mini-stun, Breaking, Slow, Immobilize)
[*] Revised attributes of some characters to be more friendly for solo players.
[*] Improved Shout Skill can now taunt enemies to move toward the user.
[*] Buffed: Heal skill of Druid Wand from 2 > 1 mana bottle.
[*] Adjusted Vine Trap's staggering time to be shorter
[*] Balanced Faith rewards after completing a quest.
[*] Adjusted Interaction Time when interacting with items.
[*] Adjusted Interaction Time when interacting with Vilcor Statue 2 Sec. -> 0.8 Sec.
[*] Rebalanced Drop Item Rewards from defeating Mini-boss.
[*] Rebalanced Drop Weapon Rewards in Treasure Boxes.
[*] Adjusted Potion Drop Chance from Destroyable Prop from 15% to 3%.
[*] Added Cast Time on Slime
[*] Nerfed Health Point on Slime
[*] Buffed Health Point on Elite Monster Type
[*] Added New Monsters, “Golden Suicider,” to the Quest Star 2+
[*] Revised Spawn Wave Pattern of Mission Leader in Elimination Quest within Quest Star 2.
[*] Monster Elimination: Adjusted the timing of Monster Spawn on each wave to make it faster.
[*] Monster Elimination: Changed the monster spawn pattern.
[*] Monster Elimination: Increased Quest Time occurs during the connecting room
[*] Revised Spawning Pattern on special monsters.
[/list] [h2][b]Bug Fixes:🐛[/b][/h2]
Squashed pesky bugs and glitches to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.
[list]
[*] Fixed resolution does not start at 1080p.
[*] Fixed material is required not to show on a tutorial quest.
[*] Fixed lobby panel does not show the last selected.
[*] Fixed dash does not move in the stick direction sometimes.
[*] Fixed Nanashi cannot attack after upgrading.
[*] Fixed selected and un-selected headers on the Collection panel.
[*] Fixed refresh text, not update real-time.
[*] Fixed dash was stuck sometimes.
[*] Fixed Fyvana's trait that her dances are not working
[*] Fixed Fire Staff cannot deal with damage
[*] Fixed Suicider became black color after being destroyed.
[*] Fixed character invincible all the time
[*] Fixed some areas in the Ruins Dungeon able to Blink through the wall
[*] Fixed Material Vilcorr always drops without Quest Activation.
[*] Fixed: If players were downed while using the skill “Targeted Assault“ of the weapon Vector, they could not attack.
[*] Fixed some traps that don't inflict status on players
[*] Fixed Treasure Box drop area not too close to the dungeon gate
[*] Fixed sometimes, players become invincible after using skills that contain skill duration.
[*] Fixed the Black Knight scene area so the players can walk on the edge and not fall to respawn.
[*] Fixed PS4 controller is not displayed as Player 1
[*] Fixed Characters in the Pause Menu are shown over the pop-up interface when a player is disconnected.
[*] Fixed some monsters that are not attacking in the same direction as their attack indicators.
[*] Fixed inability to collect healing drop of the skill “Heal “in the rocky area.
[*] Fixed Auto Aim can lock targets across the wall.
[*] Fixed black screen occurs if the players open the pause menu when changing dungeon rooms.
[/list]

We're incredibly grateful for your support and feedback, which have been invaluable in shaping this update. Your adventures in Eclipseia are just beginning, and we can't wait to see where they take you next!

Happy adventuring!
